evals.prompt: Review this repository's architecture and find the first module you would deepen. CodeGraph is already indexed; use its call paths and impact evidence, then produce the normal HTML architecture report without changing code.
evals.expected_output: A temp HTML report with candidates, graph evidence, source/test corroboration, before/after diagrams, and a top recommendation.

evals.prompt: Set up CodeGraph for this project, detect whether I am using Codex or Claude Code, inspect the skills already installed, and add the CodeGraph architecture guidance to the narrowest existing instruction file. Show the planned writes before applying them.
evals.expected_output: A bounded preflight, explicit setup plan, detected agent/skill paths, verified CodeGraph status, and a marked non-destructive instruction update.

evals.prompt: Install the tdd skill from https://github.com/mattpocock/skills for my active agent, but do not install unrelated skills or overwrite an existing copy. Report the exact source, scope, collision status, and verification result.
evals.expected_output: Only the named skill is installed or a collision is reported; the result includes exact source, target agent/scope, resolved SKILL.md, and no unrelated changes.
